name: hero-en
title: Let Jev pick, let the LLM write, and referee the ties.
alt: Jev picks, LLM writes, LLM referees ties: 18/18 correct; 12/12 after UI renames where scripts go 0/12; 1.7x faster; 3.5x cheaper
src: Correct, fast, cheap: 6 tasks x 3 runs. Robust: the return flow under 4 UI churn seeds x 3 runs. Every run judged by what the app stored, not by what the agent said. The referee setup is a separate batch; the referee was called 1 time in 30 runs. Without the referee: 17/18 and 11/12, each miss a safe stop. Data: github.com/chyiiiiiiiiiiii/flutter-jev

stats.label: Correct: as accurate as an all-LLM agent, 0 false passes
Robust: survives UI renames; scripts go 0/12
Fast: 8.5 s per run vs 14.5 s
